facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants helping a product-aware shopper understand what the six-part kit offers at the listed price. Keep the offer unchanged; no invented savings versus competitors or individual component prices.

variants.concept: Furniture edges: add a childproofing measure around low tables and furniture corners.
variants.primary_text: For a room with low tables and furniture edges, The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors to add a childproofing layer at those points. It also includes socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards. Listed at ₹3,299. A childproofing kit is an added measure; adult supervision still matters.
variants.headline: Childproofing for furniture edges and corners

variants.concept: Kitchen cabinets and fridge: focus on the included locks for a specific household concern.
variants.primary_text: Thinking about childproofing kitchen cabinets or the fridge? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks, so you can add a childproofing measure to those doors. Door guards and socket guards are included too. Listed price: ₹3,299. Use childproofing alongside adult supervision.
variants.headline: A child-safety kit with cabinet and fridge locks

variants.concept: Installation hesitation: highlight one-to-one video support and the prepaid offer.
variants.primary_text: Choosing a kit is one thing; knowing how to install its parts is another. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support to guide you through the process. It comes with edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards. Listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 prepaid savings. Adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: Childproofing kit with 1-to-1 video support

output.internal_notes: Used the supplied public marketing observations without treating them as independently verified product-safety evidence. Policy eligibility details were not supplied, so no policy claims are included. Adult supervision qualification is retained.
